additional_info.subject: RE: ID0455519-DC/Si-D/SA-[Y2 / R4 312922184004] Firm Ware Update CRM:03098000030
additional_info.body:
Dear Mr. Paulraj,
I am reaching out from the Technical Support team in regards of ticket
ID0455519
for charger Y2 / R4 312922184004.
Today I changed the name of the charger to SASCO-08 ASFAN STATION, as per requested.
In regards of the FW update, the charger was running on v3.2.8 with v4.0.11 rolled out, hence I performed the update. Before proceeding with the next FW updates, I would need the following confirmation:
As I understood from your request, you would like to update the charger to the newest FW version. Is it correct?
Being the charger on v4.0.11 now, and being the most recent FW version the v8.0.5, that would mean #4 consecutive FW updates (v4>v5>v6>v7>v8.0.5)
For each FW update, the rollout phase of the FW consumes circa 2GB of data on the SIM card of router XF3 (Siemens router)
Could you please confirm that such SIM card has enough data plan to perform the #4 FW updates (8 giga in total)?
Looking forward to hearing feedback from you soon!
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
